::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 220,826 people lived in County Meath, up 13.2% on 2016. It had the 5th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 120% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Meath was €1,542, the 6th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
